# FLX-3701: the pinned profile holds the rate of a held-out query

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

A held-out query is one the calibration never saw, so its target comes from the separate held-out profile (--held-out) and never from the profile the bundle pins. A pinned profile whose queries section names a held-out query would let the calibration fit what it is to be judged on. The message names the query. Ask the profiler for the pinned profile without that entry, or declare the query as a calibration query. Nothing was run.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3701
```
